title: EvoSelect: Data-Efficient LLM Evolution for Targeted Task Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2604.26170v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to a targeted task efficiently and effectively remains a fundamental challenge. Such adaptation often requires iteratively improving the model toward a targeted task, yet collecting high-quality human-labeled data to support this process is costly and difficult to scale. As a result, synthetic data generation has emerged as a flexible and scalable alternative. One straightforward approach is through an iterative generation-training loop, where candidate data are synthesized through an external generator, the model is updated using these data and the process is repeated over iterations. However, generated samples can be noisy, highly redundant, or even misaligned with the targeted task distribution. Training indiscriminately on such data can dilute useful learning signals and even degrade model performance. translated_title: EvoSelect：面向目标任务适配的高效数据大语言模型进化方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2604.26170v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：将大型语言模型（LLMs）高效且有效地适配到目标任务仍然是一个基本挑战。这种适配通常需要针对目标任务迭代地改进模型，但收集高质量的人工标注数据来支持这一过程成本高昂且难以扩展。因此，合成数据生成已成为一种灵活且可扩展的替代方案。一种直接的方法是通过迭代的生成-训练循环，其中候选数据由外部生成器合成，模型使用这些数据进行更新，并在多次迭代中重复该过程。然而，生成的样本可能包含噪声、高度冗余，甚至与目标任务分布不一致。不加区分地训练这些数据会稀释有用的学习信号，甚至降低模型性能。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一种精炼的范式，即迭代的生成-选择-...
tldr: 提出了一种迭代的生成-选择范式（EvoSelect），通过高效选择合成数据来避免噪声和冗余，从而提升大语言模型在目标任务上的适配效果。
en_tdlr: EvoSelect introduces an iterative generation-selection paradigm that efficiently filters synthetic data to enhance LLM adaptation for targeted tasks.
